# SAR VV Small

A tiny single-band Sentinel-1 IW GRDH-like scene (VV polarisation): uint16 detected-amplitude DNs (not dB, not calibrated backscatter), zero-valued border-noise columns, sentinel NoData 0. Generated by geocase.raster.presets, whose constants are machine-checked against a real S1A GRD annotation.

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase preserves a single-band VV SAR amplitude scene and its band naming.

## Risk types covered

- [`band_loss`](../risk/band-loss.md)
- [`dtype_drift`](../risk/dtype-drift.md)
